# Upshift

> Turn habits into quests, earn XP and keep distracting apps blocked until your quests are done. Upshift for iPhone and Android.

Website: https://joinupshift.com/
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/upshift-1-productivity-app/id6749509316
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.upshift.app
Support: support@joinupshift.com

## What Upshift does

You open your phone for one minute and lose an hour. With Upshift the apps stay locked until your quests are done.

Upshift turns your habits into quests. Finish them to earn XP and unlock the apps you blocked, and watch your streaks, goals and level grow every day.

### Quests: Your Habits Become Quests

Turn daily habits into quests and sidequests. Earn XP in Money, Strength, Health and Knowledge, build streaks and level up your life.

### Quest Blocker: Earn Your Screen Time

Distracting apps stay blocked until you finish your daily quests. Add Block Now, time limits and work schedules when you need more.

### App Blocker: Know Where Your Time Goes

See your total usage per app, then set up work schedules, adult content and gambling blocks, time limits or Block Now with one tap. Turn on strict mode and there is no way to bypass the block until it ends.

### Goals: Goals With a Real Plan

Set long-term goals, break them into micro-goals and keep a journal with your plan and reflections.

### Time Tracker: See Where Your Day Goes

Track your focus sessions and daily activity on a calendar, keep your day streak alive and look back at your history anytime.

### Profile: Watch Yourself Level Up

Your profile shows your level, XP in every category, badges and streaks. Add friends, join groups and climb the leaderboards to stay accountable.

## Frequently asked questions

### Getting Started

**What is Upshift?**

Upshift is an all-in-one productivity app that helps you transform your life from the bottom up. Your habits become quests, you earn XP and level up, and distracting apps stay blocked until the important stuff is done.

**Is there an Android version?**

Yes! Upshift is available on the App Store and on Google Play.

**Is there a free version of Upshift?**

Upshift offers 7 days of free trial, to show you why this is the app you were looking for :)

**How do XP and levels work?**

Every quest you complete earns XP in its category: Money, Strength, Health or Knowledge. XP raises your global level, unlocks badges and achievements, and shows up on your profile with the rest of your stats.

### Quests & Habits

**What is the difference between Quests and Sidequests?**

Quests are your main daily habits you want to build long-term. Sidequests are daily challenges generated by the app, offering extra XP and keeping things interesting. Complete sidequests for bonus rewards and variety!

**What kinds of quests can I create?**

One day quests work like a to-do list and can be scheduled for future days. Weekly and monthly quests run on the days you pick. Quit quests help you break bad habits by tracking them daily, and roulette quests throw random challenges at you. You can also browse Explore to discover new habits.

**Will Upshift remind me to do my quests?**

Yes. Smart reminders nudge you to complete your habits without being annoying.

**What happens when I keep a streak?**

Streak and day celebrations pop up when you stay consistent or finish your daily goals, and milestones unlock badges and achievements.

### App Blocker

**What is the Quest Blocker?**

Quest Blocker is our unique feature that blocks distracting apps until you complete your daily quests. It's a powerful motivator to get your important tasks done first before accessing entertainment apps.

**What other blocks can I set up?**

Block Now instantly blocks apps when you need to focus. Time Limits cap daily usage for apps and websites. Work Schedule blocks distracting apps during work hours. There are also pre-built blocks such as the porn blocker, and each block type has its own custom overlay.

**Can I get around a block?**

With strict mode on, a block cannot be bypassed until the app is unblocked (depending on the block type). That is the point, even on the easiest settings.

**Can I trust you with my screen time data?**

You don't have to! Upshift is built on top of Apple's Screen Time technology. Apple built it with privacy in mind, so we can't view your screen time even if we wanted to.

### Goals & Focus

**How do goals work?**

Set long-term goals and break them into micro-goals. Each goal has a journal where you write your plan and reflections, and you get deadline reminders along the way.

**Can I track my time?**

Yes. The time tracker shows where your day goes, and the focus timer times your sessions so you can see how productive you were.

### Friends & Profile

**Can I use Upshift with friends?**

Add friends, share your progress, and join groups with shared challenges and leaderboards to stay accountable.

**Can I customize the app?**

Pick from 9 themes for your profile and add Upshift widgets to your home screen.

**What is the Affiliate Program?**

Share Upshift with others and earn rewards through our Affiliate Program. When people sign up using your referral code/username, you earn credits that can be used to redeem a bunch of rewards.
